'''Rockfish''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. Rockfish could be served [[Raw rockfish twist|raw]] and eaten as part of a meal,<ref name="LE" /> and was served aboard the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] [[Gem of Alderaan]]<ref name="GA">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref> and at the annual [[Vor-cal Feast]] held aboard the [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]].<ref name="LE" />
